images.title: The 46th fold passes the Moon
images.purpose: Shows that fold 45 (about 351844 km) is still short of the Moon at 384400 km, and doubling once more to fold 46 (about 703687 km) passes it.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One long horizontal distance line with three markers and one doubling arc.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal line in dark outline from 0 at the left end to a little past 700000 km at the right, with no other ticks or numbers. Three markers stand on it: a teal (#0072B2) dot at about half of the length labelled fold 45: 351844 km below it; a plain white circle with a dark outline slightly to the right of it, at about 0.55 of the length, labelled Moon: 384400 km above it; a reddish purple (#CC79A7) dot near the right end labelled fold 46: 703687 km below it. One amber (#E69F00) curved arrow arches from the fold 45 dot over the Moon to the fold 46 dot, labelled × 2. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: Fold 45 falls short of the Moon, and one more doubling passes it.
images.description: Shows that fold 45 (about 351844 km) is still short of the Moon at 384400 km, and doubling once more to fold 46 (about 703687 km) passes it.
images.context: 0.001 × 2 to the power 45 cm = 351843.7 km; × 2 to the power 46 cm = 703687.4 km.

image_decisions.why: The practice ends on the table's last rows, so the picture shows the fold that crosses the Moon distance.
